verses.ar: اَلرَّبُّ قَدْ مَلَكَ. لَبِسَ ٱلْجَلَالَ. لَبِسَ ٱلرَّبُّ ٱلْقُدْرَةَ، ٱئْتَزَرَ بِهَا. أَيْضًا تَثَبَّتَتِ ٱلْمَسْكُونَةُ. لَا تَتَزَعْزَعُ.
verses.kjv: The LORD reigneth, he is clothed with majesty; the LORD is clothed with strength, [wherewith] he hath girded himself: the world also is stablished, that it cannot be moved.
verses.web: Yahweh reigns! He is clothed with majesty! Yahweh is armed with strength. The world also is established. It can’t be moved.

verses.ar: كُرْسِيُّكَ مُثْبَتَةٌ مُنْذُ ٱلْقِدَمِ. مُنْذُ ٱلْأَزَلِ أَنْتَ.
verses.kjv: Thy throne [is] established of old: thou [art] from everlasting.
verses.web: Your throne is established from long ago. You are from everlasting.

verses.ar: رَفَعَتِ ٱلْأَنْهَارُ يَارَبُّ، رَفَعَتِ ٱلْأَنْهَارُ صَوْتَهَا. تَرْفَعُ ٱلْأَنْهَارُ عَجِيجَهَا.
verses.kjv: The floods have lifted up, O LORD, the floods have lifted up their voice; the floods lift up their waves.
verses.web: The floods have lifted up, Yahweh, the floods have lifted up their voice. The floods lift up their waves.

verses.ar: مِنْ أَصْوَاتِ مِيَاهٍ كَثِيرَةٍ، مِنْ غِمَارِ أَمْوَاجِ ٱلْبَحْرِ، ٱلرَّبُّ فِي ٱلْعُلَى أَقْدَرُ.
verses.kjv: The LORD on high [is] mightier than the noise of many waters, [yea, than] the mighty waves of the sea.
verses.web: Above the voices of many waters, the mighty breakers of the sea, Yahweh on high is mighty.

verses.ar: شَهَادَاتُكَ ثَابِتَةٌ جِدًّا. بِبَيْتِكَ تَلِيقُ ٱلْقَدَاسَةُ يَارَبُّ إِلَى طُولِ ٱلْأَيَّامِ.
verses.kjv: Thy testimonies are very sure: holiness becometh thine house, O LORD, for ever.
verses.web: Your statutes stand firm. Holiness adorns your house, Yahweh, forever more.
